words.headline: Tuesday Chill Check: No-Heat Calls Hit 1,846, Way Above Usual
words.blurb: With a low of 38°F, New Yorkers reported 1,846 no-heat or hot-water problems on Tuesday, versus a typical 1,119. Single-apartment no-heat calls nearly doubled, from 227 to 442.

boroughs.Bronx: Home repairs led with 886 reports, and 662 no-heat calls kept the radiators busy.
boroughs.Brooklyn: Parking wars ruled at 1,132 reports, with home repairs close behind at 782.
boroughs.Manhattan: Home repairs topped at 558, noise right behind at 510, no heat at 477.
boroughs.Queens: Parking wars dominated with 885 reports, more than double home repairs at 352.
boroughs.Staten Island: Parking wars led a quiet day with 65, then street fixes at 43.
